notes: ARC Prize public leaderboard, headless-Chrome DOM dump 2026-10-07 (the page is client-rendered; the 282-row table was parsed from the rendered HTML). Same-snapshot rows for GPT-6.1 Sol (new since 2026-09-29) and the peers GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Grok 4.7, Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / V4 Pro 0813, GLM-5.3-Flash, Kimi K3. Effort is the row label's own parenthesised level ('None' is stored as effort none). ARC-AGI-1 and -2 cost is per task; ARC-AGI-3 cost is total suite cost (unit other) and Standard and Provider Adapter harnesses are separate snapshots/groups. Earlier ARC rows already in the pack for peers re-read here are not removed; any differences would show as a second same-model row. Models on the board not stored: Qwen3.8-27B, Gemini 3.7/3.6 Flash, Grok 4.6/4.5, GPT-5.6 family, older Claude/Gemini/GPT rows.

claims.statement: ARC Prize now lists GPT-6.1 Sol (released 2026-09-29) at five efforts. ARC-AGI-2 (accuracy, $/task): max 94.2% $0.254, xhigh 91.7% $0.178, high 91.7% $0.135, medium 86.7% $0.100, low 76.7% $0.086; ARC-AGI-1: max 96.5% $0.095, xhigh 98.5% $0.074, high 98.5% $0.059, medium 95.5% $0.050, low 93.5% $0.047. Same snapshot: GPT-6 Astra max ARC-AGI-2 95.0% at $1.12, Opus 5.5 high 93.3% at $0.408 (max 91.7% at $1.85). GPT-6.1 Sol high matches Opus 5.5 xhigh on ARC-AGI-2 within 1 pp at about a fifth of the cost.

ARC-AGI-3 (Standard harness, total suite cost): GPT-6.1 Sol max 52.7% ($7.6K), xhigh 39.9% ($9.1K), high 26.7%, medium 10.6%, low 3.9%; GPT-6 Sol max 4.6%; GPT-6 Astra max 62.7% ($26.1K). The Provider Adapter harness gives 96.2% for Sol max ($3.8K) and 98.6% for Astra max ($17.3K); the two harnesses must not be compared.
